
Three arXiv papers from the current RSS batch meet ≥3 inclusion criteria: CogniConsole formalizes inference-time control as a harness abstraction; Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench provides a terminal-task evaluation harness with dense reward grading; Scoped Verification addresses harness-layer context state management under distribution shift.

## Suggestions

- [CogniConsole: Externalizing Inference-Time Control as a Formal Abstraction for Reliable LLM Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08774) — Formalizes inference-time control as an explicit harness-layer abstraction, externalizing execution control from the model to improve reliability of LLM interactions.
  Section: Research Papers > Agent-Computer Interfaces & Scaffolding Design | Criteria: Defines or implements the execution loop, scaffolding, or runtime environment that hosts an AI agent, Manages tool dispatch, context handling, state management, or safety constraints at the harness layer, Empirical or production evidence of harness design improving reliability, safety, or performance

- [Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08964) — Evaluation harness for long-horizon terminal-task agents with sandboxed execution environments and dense reward-based grading for fine-grained behavioral assessment.
  Section: Evaluation Harnesses | Criteria: Defines or implements the execution loop, scaffolding, or runtime environment that hosts an AI agent, Evaluates or benchmarks agent behavior through controlled harness-mediated interactions, Empirical or production evidence of harness design improving reliability, safety, or performance

- [Scoped Verification for Reliable Long-Horizon Agentic Context Evolution under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09175) — Proposes scoped verification mechanisms for managing agentic context state evolution across long-horizon tasks under distribution shift, with reliability evidence at the harness layer.
  Section: Research Papers > Context & State Management | Criteria: Manages tool dispatch, context handling, state management, or safety constraints at the harness layer, Evaluates or benchmarks agent behavior through controlled harness-mediated interactions, Empirical or production evidence of harness design improving reliability, safety, or performance
